Source intake: pdr-three-bean-salad

Source candidate only. Method summaries are paraphrased; UK ingredient names and selected branches are identified in the intake. No human review or planning admission is established.

Published yield: 8 source servings. Source panel states 8 servings; whether these are side or main-meal portions is not established.

Published timing: Source prep label: 10 minutes. Source requires at least 60 minutes in the fridge before serving. The 10-minute prep label excludes the mandatory one-hour refrigeration; minimum 70 minutes is an inference if these are sequential, not a published tested total. Active time and a complete elapsed-time schedule are unqualified.

Method summary:
1. Whisk the dressing in a salad bowl.
2. Rinse and drain the three tins through a colander.
3. Chop vegetables and gently combine with the dressing and beans.
4. Refrigerate for at least one hour, stirring occasionally, before serving.

Equipment from the source method: salad bowl, whisk, colander, knife, refrigerator.

evidence_documents.authored_input_specification: Root adopted this separately authored, conditional vegetarian input specification under the B commission. It is not a vegetarian claim made by the published recipe or any actual retailer product. Prepare exactly two independently measured, covered home-lunch containers. Each uses 80 g each newly opened, commercially cooked, ready-to-eat, vegetarian-compatible canned kidney beans, chickpeas and black beans weighed after rinse/drain; 40 g edible carrot, 20 g peeled onion, 60 g edible bell pepper, 10 ml plain olive oil, 15 ml plain cider vinegar and 5 g plain sugar. All nine inputs and their applicable processing must satisfy the rule: no animal body-part ingredients, or products/processing aids made from them; no meat/fish/bone stocks, carcass fats, gelatine or isinglass. Actual manufacturing, processing, cross-contact, labels, dates and native matched-product policy remain unverified. The fixed quantities and two operational-unit yield are unchanged from rc05, not source-serving, net-can recovery, density, finished dish mass, nutrition or human portion calibration. full_method.text: Use clean hands and clean food-contact scales, measures, colander, utensils, board and two separate covered containers; keep non-vegetarian materials and residues out of this preparation. Check actual labels and credible supplier/manufacturer information needed to establish vegetarian-compatible, ready-to-eat inputs and their applicable processing. The rule is: no animal body-part ingredients, or products/processing aids made from them; no meat/fish/bone stocks, carcass fats, gelatine or isinglass. Do not infer compliance from a plant name, this recipe, a brand or an absent allergen declaration; if an input condition cannot be established, do not claim vegetarian service from it. Use only newly opened, commercially cooked, ready-to-eat canned beans whose actual cold-use, date and storage labels permit this handling. For EACH container independently rinse/drain and weigh 80 g each kidney beans, chickpeas and black beans; wash/trim 40 g edible carrot and 60 g edible bell pepper, peel/chop 20 g onion; measure 10 ml plain olive oil, 15 ml plain cider vinegar and 5 g plain sugar. All nine inputs must be vegetarian-compatible under the stated rule. Mix each separate dressing, then its own beans and vegetables; no common bowl/estimated half split, seasoning, stock, substitute or unlisted garnish. Transfer unused opened-can contents according to actual labels to covered non-metallic refrigerated containers; they are outside this plan/stock. Cover both completed units for phase 2. Reserve 30 minutes of full attention as an unmeasured maker estimate, not measured completion.

Keep BOTH separate, covered salad units in a working home fridge at 0–5 °C for at least 60 minutes, retaining the published minimum. No mid-chill stirring is included. Continue chilling each container if needed until properly chilled; the 60-minute field and nominal 90-minute planning interval do not establish thermal completion or guarantee the meal deadline. Keep both properly chilled until same-day home service and minimise time out. If either is not properly chilled at the deadline, continue refrigeration and delay/refuse that service. No travel, ambient-safe interval, acid preservation, storage life, reheating, leftover or reuse permission is supplied. Keep these exact vegetarian-input units separate from non-vegetarian preparation and food-contact residues. No new dressing, stock, garnish or other ingredient is added during chilling or service. The complete method and all nine inputs are included in the conditional composition review. These instructions are not observations of factory/kitchen cross-contact control, allergen absence, actual product suitability or physical chilling completion. If the separately reviewed declared chicken extra is selected, keep BOTH covered salad units protected while its separately timed dedicated counter method is performed. Do not put chicken into either salad or share utensils/contact residues. Optional animal extras are excluded from this base composition review; the chicken recipient’s combined meal is not described as vegetarian. If that separation cannot be upheld, refuse affected service.

Each uses 80 g each newly opened, commercially cooked, ready-to-eat, vegetarian-compatible canned kidney beans, chickpeas and black beans weighed after rinse/drain; 40 g edible carrot, 20 g peeled onion, 60 g edible bell pepper, 10 ml plain olive oil, 15 ml plain cider vinegar and 5 g plain sugar. All nine inputs and their applicable processing must satisfy the rule: no animal body-part ingredients, or products/processing aids made from them; no meat/fish/bone stocks, carcass fats, gelatine or isinglass. Actual manufacturing, processing, cross-contact, labels, dates and native matched-product policy remain unverified. The fixed quantities and two operational-unit yield are unchanged from rc05, not source-serving, net-can recovery, density, finished dish mass, nutrition or human portion calibration. Exactly two confirmed Adult Regular ×1 people, at least one resident and at most one temporary guest, at-home Lunch with Fridge and first handling/service in the same local day. Only confirmed None or exactly Vegetarian per attendee/shared base is supported; Vegan, gluten-free, allergens, ingredient exclusions and every other/additional hard requirement remain unknown and refused. Reserve 30 minutes of full attention as an unmeasured assembly estimate, then at least 60 minutes of passive, covered home-fridge chilling at 0–5 °C. First handling and ingredient-needed-at are nominal T−90 minutes. Continue chilling and delay/refuse service if either container is not properly chilled. No certification, GMO, animal-testing, product suitability, cook-test, nutrition, image, portable, storage/reuse authority for arbitrary extras is supplied. This new variant declares exactly one optional separate chicken recipe; it never changes the nine-input base composition or either operational unit. The base remains conditional Vegetarian/None; a recipient consuming chicken does not receive a vegetarian combined meal. Zero or one selected extra is permitted only after the separately reviewed exact child recipe is independently admitted/resolvable, even when this base is selected without its extra. The child is served separately to one explicitly selected current confirmed-None Adult Regular×1 attendee and shares no salad utensils or food-contact residues. The extra recipe has its own Unheated T−5 clock and unmeasured five-minute counter phase; it does not reset the base T−90 first handling or T−60 minimum passive chill. No continuous extra Fridge reservation or capacity/access/physical separation guarantee is inferred. Every original intrinsic base input and full-method condition continues to apply.

steps.text: Use clean hands and clean food-contact scales, measures, colander, utensils, board and two separate covered containers; keep non-vegetarian materials and residues out of this preparation. Check actual labels and credible supplier/manufacturer information needed to establish vegetarian-compatible, ready-to-eat inputs and their applicable processing. The rule is: no animal body-part ingredients, or products/processing aids made from them; no meat/fish/bone stocks, carcass fats, gelatine or isinglass. Do not infer compliance from a plant name, this recipe, a brand or an absent allergen declaration; if an input condition cannot be established, do not claim vegetarian service from it. Use only newly opened, commercially cooked, ready-to-eat canned beans whose actual cold-use, date and storage labels permit this handling. For EACH container independently rinse/drain and weigh 80 g each kidney beans, chickpeas and black beans; wash/trim 40 g edible carrot and 60 g edible bell pepper, peel/chop 20 g onion; measure 10 ml plain olive oil, 15 ml plain cider vinegar and 5 g plain sugar. All nine inputs must be vegetarian-compatible under the stated rule. Mix each separate dressing, then its own beans and vegetables; no common bowl/estimated half split, seasoning, stock, substitute or unlisted garnish. Transfer unused opened-can contents according to actual labels to covered non-metallic refrigerated containers; they are outside this plan/stock. Cover both completed units for phase 2. Reserve 30 minutes of full attention as an unmeasured maker estimate, not measured completion.

Keep BOTH separate, covered salad units in a working home fridge at 0–5 °C for at least 60 minutes, retaining the published minimum. No mid-chill stirring is included. Continue chilling each container if needed until properly chilled; the 60-minute field and nominal 90-minute planning interval do not establish thermal completion or guarantee the meal deadline. Keep both properly chilled until same-day home service and minimise time out. If either is not properly chilled at the deadline, continue refrigeration and delay/refuse that service. No travel, ambient-safe interval, acid preservation, storage life, reheating, leftover or reuse permission is supplied. Keep these exact vegetarian-input units separate from non-vegetarian preparation and food-contact residues. No new dressing, stock, garnish or other ingredient is added during chilling or service. The complete method and all nine inputs are included in the conditional composition review. These instructions are not observations of factory/kitchen cross-contact control, allergen absence, actual product suitability or physical chilling completion. If the separately reviewed declared chicken extra is selected, keep BOTH covered salad units protected while its separately timed dedicated counter method is performed. Do not put chicken into either salad or share utensils/contact residues. Optional animal extras are excluded from this base composition review; the chicken recipient’s combined meal is not described as vegetarian. If that separation cannot be upheld, refuse affected service.
